The rest was sharp: farm well above her usual pace and kills in three of our won fights, two on Argus.

66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: Soulbearer is a mage crest. Its magical power and mana do little for a physical bruiser; its ability haste and its active's shield and movement speed are the parts Zarus uses. Brutallax, a fighter crest, trades those for physical power, health and omnivamp, plus a cleanse and tenacity that basic attacks extend, which answers Aurora's root-and-stun chain directly.

Twelve wards, all three of our ward clears and the team's biggest healing total are real work. Before the first Fangtooth, Phase only trades forward when Khaimera is on our side of the map, and saves Phase Blink for the exit.
